what: When the fixed header goes down past 80px, a background-color arch panel (a curve sagging in the middle + a thin border in line color) lays down in .45s, and the logo, links and buttons drop onto the arch curve according to their position across the header width and tilt (.8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)) — center items drop a lot, the two ends lift up and tilt outward. After that, scrolling down past 6px hides the header upward (.65s) and scrolling up past 6px brings it back.

options.at: Scroll distance (px) at which the arch starts to spread, default 80
options.hide: If false, does not hide on scroll down
options.--fx-dur · --fx-hide-dur · --fx-depth: Slope length .8s · hide length .65s · arch panel depth .28
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Items seated along the arch (logo, link li, button)
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Inner line to measure width and height (optional) — if absent, the element itself

use: Menu 1LogoMenu 2
note: The Motion part inserts the arch panel (svg) at the very front of the element and excludes it on detach. The element needs a position (usually fixed)
